title: Money value type where the accessors look too trivial to test
task: Implement a `Money` value type in package `money` holding cents and a currency code: `Add` (same currency only, error otherwise), `Times(quantity int)`, `Allocate(parts int) []Money` handing out the remainder one cent at a time from the first part, and `String()` like `EUR 12.34`. The accessors are trivial, so use your judgment on how much of this deserves a test.
